title: 🔆🔅TEHRAN, October 13, Mohammad Reza Naqdi, Advisor to the Commander-in-Chief of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), made remarks in an interview.
text:
🔆🔅TEHRAN, October 13, Mohammad Reza Naqdi, Advisor to the Commander-in-Chief of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), made remarks in an interview."

""
"SOT1, Mohammad Reza Naqdi, Advisor to the Commander-in-Chief of the IRGC (Farsi)-(00:00 - 00:42): "You fire a missile and suddenly you see 200 Americans killed in Jordan. They don't report it, but their Red Crescent personnel report it to us, saying, 'We collected so many bodies here,' while they [Americans] claim 18 people have been killed since the war began until now. That is one of the jokes! They say only 18 people from the US Army have been killed in this war! Those hotels that were hit in Bahrain, the UAE, and elsewhere: from early evening until dawn, ambulances were coming and going nonstop. Were those people jinn who were killed there?""

"SOT2, Mohammad Reza Naqdi, Advisor to the Commander-in-Chief of the IRGC (Farsi)-(00:43 - 01:12): "What wise man calculates and decides on a ground invasion? The fate of a ground invasion is clear! If they spent $3,000-$4,000 billion there [in Iraq and Afghanistan], how many thousand billion dollars would they spend here? If it took 20 years there, how long will it take here? It will not even take 20 days for them to give up; we will take so many prisoners from them that they will come and surrender themselves and raise the white flag.""

"SOT3, Mohammad Reza Naqdi, Advisor to the Commander-in-Chief of the IRGC (Farsi)-(01:13 - 01:55): "I do not think they have even had a very rudimentary preliminary discussion among themselves about a ground invasion; such decisions were not even formed in the bud, they did not take shape even in their minds because they know they cannot do this. They have a navy whose fleet has been wandering around for seven months. Their fleet headquarters is in Bahrain; the headquarters of these ships is there. They have been in the Persian Gulf for a hundred years, and since the start of the war, they fled a thousand kilometers away and cannot come back.""

"SOT4, Mohammad Reza Naqdi, Advisor to the Commander-in-Chief of the IRGC (Farsi)-(01:56 - 02:29): "When the meeting is held, all these people come, right at the height of the war, during those peak days of war when the clashes were intense. They come, the ambassadors of these very Persian Gulf countries where we are hitting American targets, and shake hands with us. They whisper in our ears, 'Hit them!' Meaning, you are not the only one saying, 'Hit them and do it well.' That prince who is the ambassador there says, 'Hit them!' This is the capacity; this is the opportunity.
